SELECT
      timezone('UTC', CAST("budget_vs_actual".month || '-01' AS DATE)::timestamptz) "budget_vs_actual__month"
    FROM
      (WITH h AS (SELECT month, entity, round(sum(revenue_eur), 2) AS a1, round(sum(revenue_refund_date_eur), 2) AS a2
           FROM (WITH ord AS (SELECT order_month_local AS month, sum(net_of_vat_eur) AS v, sum(refunds_eur) AS r FROM intermediate.int_orders_enriched GROUP BY 1),
           ref AS (SELECT strftime(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki', '%Y-%m') AS month, sum(amount_eur) AS r
                   FROM staging.stg_shopify__refunds GROUP BY 1)
           SELECT month, entity, revenue_stream, revenue_eur, revenue_eur AS revenue_refund_date_eur FROM intermediate.int_revenue_by_entity_month
           WHERE revenue_stream NOT IN ('Intercompany', 'Webshop')
           UNION ALL
           SELECT coalesce(ord.month, ref.month), 'Nordlund Verkkokauppa', 'Webshop', round(coalesce(ord.v, 0) - coalesce(ord.r, 0) / 1.255, 2),
                  round(coalesce(ord.v, 0) - coalesce(ref.r, 0) / 1.255, 2)
           FROM ord FULL JOIN ref USING (month)) GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT b.month, b.entity, b.line_item, b.budget_eur,
       CASE WHEN b.entity = 'Nordlund Verkkokauppa' THEN h.a1 ELSE b.actual_eur END AS actual_eur,
       CASE WHEN b.entity = 'Nordlund Verkkokauppa' THEN h.a2 ELSE b.actual_eur END AS actual_refund_date_eur
FROM marts_finance.mart_budget_vs_actual_monthly b LEFT JOIN h USING (month, entity)
WHERE b.month <= '2026-08') AS "budget_vs_actual"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', CAST("group_revenue_handbook_monthly".month || '-01' AS DATE)::timestamptz) "group_revenue_handbook_monthly__month"
    FROM
      (WITH ord AS (SELECT order_month_local AS month, sum(net_of_vat_eur) AS v, sum(refunds_eur) AS r FROM intermediate.int_orders_enriched GROUP BY 1),
ref AS (SELECT strftime(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki', '%Y-%m') AS month, sum(amount_eur) AS r
        FROM staging.stg_shopify__refunds GROUP BY 1)
SELECT month, entity, revenue_stream, revenue_eur, revenue_eur AS revenue_refund_date_eur FROM intermediate.int_revenue_by_entity_month
WHERE revenue_stream NOT IN ('Intercompany', 'Webshop')
UNION ALL
SELECT coalesce(ord.month, ref.month), 'Nordlund Verkkokauppa', 'Webshop', round(coalesce(ord.v, 0) - coalesce(ord.r, 0) / 1.255, 2),
       round(coalesce(ord.v, 0) - coalesce(ref.r, 0) / 1.255, 2)
FROM ord FULL JOIN ref USING (month)) AS "group_revenue_handbook_monthly"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', "webshop_orders".created_at_local::timestamptz) "webshop_orders__created_at_local"
    FROM
      intermediate.int_orders_enriched AS "webshop_orders"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', "webshop_orders".created_at_utc::timestamptz) "webshop_orders__created_at_utc"
    FROM
      intermediate.int_orders_enriched AS "webshop_orders"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', CAST("webshop_orders".order_month_local || '-01' AS DATE)::timestamptz) "webshop_orders__order_month_local"
    FROM
      intermediate.int_orders_enriched AS "webshop_orders"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', CAST("webshop_orders".order_month_utc || '-01' AS DATE)::timestamptz) "webshop_orders__order_month_utc"
    FROM
      intermediate.int_orders_enriched AS "webshop_orders"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      "webshop_products".category "webshop_products__category", sum("webshop_order_lines".refund_allocated_eur) / NULLIF(sum("webshop_order_lines".line_total_eur), 0) "webshop_order_lines__line_refund_rate"
    FROM
      (SELECT l.*, coalesce(o.refunds_eur, 0) * l.line_total_eur / nullif(sum(l.line_total_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY l.order_id), 0) AS refund_allocated_eur
FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_shopify.order_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, line_number ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC) = 1) AS webshop_order_lines
WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted) AS l LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_orders_enriched AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id) AS "webshop_order_lines"
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_shopify.product QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC) = 1) AS webshop_products
WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted) AS "webshop_products" ON "webshop_order_lines".product_id = "webshop_products".product_id
LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_orders_enriched AS "webshop_orders" ON "webshop_order_lines".order_id = "webshop_orders".order_id  WHERE ("webshop_orders".created_at_local >= ?::timestamptz AND "webshop_orders".created_at_local <= ?::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
      "webshop_products".category "webshop_products__category", sum("webshop_order_lines".refund_allocated_eur) / NULLIF(sum("webshop_order_lines".line_total_eur), 0) "webshop_order_lines__line_refund_rate"
    FROM
      (SELECT l.*, coalesce(o.refunds_eur, 0) * l.line_total_eur / nullif(sum(l.line_total_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY l.order_id), 0) AS refund_allocated_eur
FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_shopify.order_line QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, line_number ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC) = 1) AS webshop_order_lines
WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted) AS l LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_orders_enriched AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id) AS "webshop_order_lines"
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_shopify.product QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY _fivetran_synced DESC) = 1) AS webshop_products
WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted) AS "webshop_products" ON "webshop_order_lines".product_id = "webshop_products".product_id
LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_orders_enriched AS "webshop_orders" ON "webshop_order_lines".order_id = "webshop_orders".order_id  WHERE ("webshop_orders".created_at_local >= ?::timestamptz AND "webshop_orders".created_at_local <= ?::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 51

SELECT
      timezone('UTC', "webshop_revenue_events".event_at::timestamptz) "webshop_revenue_events__event_at"
    FROM
      (SELECT 'order' AS kind, o.order_id, o.channel, o.created_at_local AS event_at, o.net_of_vat_eur AS amount_ex_vat_eur
FROM intermediate.int_orders_enriched o
UNION ALL
SELECT 'refund', r.order_id, o.channel, r.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki',
       - round(r.amount_eur / 1.255, 2)
FROM staging.stg_shopify__refunds r LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_orders_enriched o USING (order_id)) AS "webshop_revenue_events"  GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

cubes.description: Board budget (approved December 2025, fixed, set at the planning rate 10.80 EUR/SEK) vs actual revenue by entity and month. Actuals are at the monthly average rate, so Bergström's variance carries an FX component. The budget is not the target - targets live in revenue_vs_target. The actual is the finance-handbook revenue (group_revenue_handbook_monthly) - the webshop line is ex-VAT, Helsinki time and net of refunds - netted against their own orders' month in actual_vs_budget_eur, in the month issued in actual_refund_date_eur (overlay ambiguous webshop_refund_basis); the mart's own webshop actual (GL account 3040, UTC, refunds not netted) is not served.

Contracting and service contracts on invoice from the Netvisor GL (NETVISOR journal only), Bergström Rör on invoice from the Fortnox export at the monthly average EUR/SEK rate, the webshop on the order in Helsinki time, net of VAT AND net of refunds (refunds ex-VAT) - netted against their own orders' month in revenue_eur, in the month they were issued in revenue_refund_date_eur (the handbook does not say which; overlay ambiguous webshop_refund_basis). Intercompany is eliminated. This is the carrier of group revenue and of revenue by entity / stream; the GL-booked webshop line (UTC month, refunds not netted) is group_revenue_monthly.
